description: Run declarative assertions on an agent trace (OpenAI tool calls, Anthropic tool_use, LangChain run trees, ReAct logs). Deterministic, no LLM. Assertions: order (tool A before B), must_call, must_not_call, max/min calls, no_error, recovery (a successful step after the last error), no_injection, no_pii. A step is errored when the trace marks it (is_error, status error/failed, success:false) or its text starts with Error:/Traceback — prose is never keyword-scanned. Verdict PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE (0 steps parsed, never PASS).

sensitivity.description: [no_injection] Default low (critical patterns only); higher also fires on ordinary text.

type.description: no_injection scans tool results (indirect injection); no_pii scans the final answer. Both report types and counts, never values.

types.description: [no_pii] Comma-separated: email, phone, ssn, credit_card, ip_address, jwt. Default all.

trace.description: The trace: JSON (messages array, run tree) or a Thought/Action/Observation text log.

name: validate_agent_trajectory
